findings.title: remove() always queries DB for the IDP, even when the alias is already cached
findings.body: The new line `IdentityProviderModel storedIdp = idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias);` is executed unconditionally on every `remove()` call, but in the cache-hit branch (lines 105-108) the `CachedIdentityProvider cached` is already available from the alias cache. The cached IDP could be passed to `registerIDPLoginInvalidation(...)` on line 111 (mirroring how `registerIDPInvalidation(cached.getIdentityProvider())` is already done on line 107), avoiding the extra DB round-trip in the warm-cache case. Previously, `idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias)` was only invoked inside the `isInvalid(cacheKey)` branch; the hoisted fetch now runs on every remove, which is a regression for the common case where the alias cache is populated.
